topic.title: Types of Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: supports two types of review tasks: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks.

body.p: Project Review Tasks and Independent Review Tasks support different review scenarios. Use the following information to understand how they differ.

row.entry: Project authors, owners, and invited reviewers
Review content managed in a project

section.title: Project Review Tasks
section.p: Project Review Tasks are created from content in projects. They are part of the project workflow, and task owners can integrate accepted changes back into the project at the end of the review process.

Only users with the Author role can create Project Review Tasks. All users with the Author role who have access to the project can see the review tasks created in that project. In addition, the task owner and any invited reviewers can see and access the task.
Use this type when the content is already managed in a project.

section.title: Independent Review Tasks
section.p: Independent Review Tasks are not tied to a project. They are useful when the reviewed content is outside a project or when you start the review from a supported desktop tool.
Users with the Author role and users with the Subject-Matter Expert role can create Independent Review Tasks. Only the task owner and invited reviewers can see and access the task.
Any follow-up integration is handled outside the review task workflow.

To create Independent Review Tasks from desktop tools, install the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector add-on. It integrates into Oxygen XML Editor and Oxygen XML Author. For more information, see the Oxygen Content Fusion Connector Add-on Documentation.
